text:
alexa: quick sync — acme pilot launch needs a final scope handshake. we have three cross-team blockers: (1) HSM requirement from security, (2) runtime KV prefill / batching profile, (3) infra prewarm slots. can we confirm if we ship with full HSM or HSM-fallback at launch? owners + blockers by EOD pls :hourglass_flowing_sand:
matt: from eng side — feature parity is fine with HSM-fallback (we can degrade to customer-managed KMS for initial cohort). main risk is the telemetry hooks; need a small contract change. owner: matt. ETA: Thu EOD. :+1:
jordan: runtime notes — KV prefill for top-10 queries reduces p99 by ~120ms but increases token cost. we can do conservative prefix cache + continuous batching. need to lock batch_size and max_latency SLOs. owner: jordan. asking runtime infra for test slots to validate perf on 2k qps load test.
sam: infra can reserve 4 prewarm slots for the pilot day. cost estimate + approval required from finance. I'll file ticket INF-4829 and tag @matt and @jordan. provision ETA: Fri AM.
sana: security — full HSM path requires certs + auditable key lifecycle docs. we can approve HSM-fallback but we need a clear canary gating rule and rollback plan. Also need to confirm that fallback path doesn't leak key material (it won't). owner: sana. docs ETA: Fri EOD.
emily: from product/customer — acme legal insists on HSM for production but will accept pilot on HSM-fallback if we provide explicit SLA exceptions and a data-retention cert. if we go fallback, acceptance criteria: 1) p99 latency < 450ms, 2) error rate < 0.5%, 3) documented fallback behavior in runbook. owner: emily.
deploy-bot: Deploy queued: pilot-prep-v3 -> staging (CI: 6 tests failed). See logs: https://ci.redwood/pilot-prep-v3/build/122
matt: noted on CI flakes — will triage failing tests today, likely infra mocks.
alexa: decision proposal: launch pilot with HSM-fallback, require canary gated rollout (5% -> 25% -> 100%) and the three owners to sign off. action items:
- matt: telemetry contract change + triage CI (INF-4829 link). due Thu EOD.
- jordan: run 2k qps perf run using reserved slots + share perf dashboard. due Fri AM.
- sana: finalize HSM acceptance docs and canary gating criteria. due Fri EOD.
- sam: create provisioning PR and cost estimate. due Fri AM.
- emily: finalize customer-facing acceptance checklist and legal note. due Fri EOD.
If anyone objects to HSM-fallback plan, speak now. otherwise i'll lock scope and update the launch checklist. :memo: 
alexa: cc @sana @jordan @sam @matt @emily :thumbsup:
